description: This file implements an AST traverser for removing dynamic indexing of non-SSBO vectors and matrices in shader code, replacing them with function calls that handle component selection. It includes functions for generating index access functions, traverser class implementation, and specific removal functions for different cases.

classes.name: RemoveDynamicIndexingTraverser
classes.description: A class that traverses the AST to identify and replace dynamic indexing of vectors and matrices with function calls, handling side effects and insertion of helper functions.

methods.name: GetIndexFunctionName
methods.description: Generates the name of the index access function based on the type and whether it is for reading or writing.

methods.name: CreateIntConstantNode
methods.description: Creates a constant integer node with a specified value.

methods.name: EnsureSignedInt
methods.description: Converts a node to a signed integer type if it is not already.

methods.name: GetFieldType
methods.description: Returns the field type for a vector or matrix component.

methods.name: GetBaseType
methods.description: Returns the base type for indexing functions, setting high precision and qualifiers.

methods.name: GetIndexFunctionDefinition
methods.description: Creates a function definition for dynamic index access (read or write) for a specific type.

methods.name: RemoveDynamicIndexingTraverser::visitBinary
methods.description: Handles traversal of binary nodes, replacing indirect index operations with function calls or side effect management.

methods.name: RemoveDynamicIndexingIf
methods.description: Runs the traversal and replacement process on the AST, inserting helper functions and validating the result.
